questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to make new friends at a new job
Famous plays by Shakespeare about love
What jealousy is and how to deal with it
Why people cancel their lunch plans
questions.why: They discuss jealousy to find out what happens when 'the green-eyed monster' appears.

questions.q: Why does Neil feel jealous at the start?
options: Alicia cancelled lunch to eat with Jenny again
Sam got a promotion at work instead of him
Jenny bought a new car and showed it off
Alicia forgot his birthday this year
questions.why: Alicia cancelled lunch, and it's the third time this week she's had lunch with Jenny.

questions.q: According to Dr Alex Mielke, when do people feel jealous?
options: When someone has something that they want
When they lose a competition or a game
When they are alone for a long time
When someone else threatens a relationship
questions.why: He says jealousy is the feeling that a relationship is threatened by someone else.

questions.q: How is envy different from jealousy?
options: Envy involves three people
Envy is about wanting what someone else has
Envy happens only in romantic relationships
Envy is always stronger than jealousy
questions.why: Envy is wanting what someone else has, and involves just two people.

questions.q: Which example of controlling behaviour caused by jealousy is mentioned?
options: Checking a partner's text messages
Buying expensive presents
Refusing to go to work
Moving to another city
questions.why: Neil mentions checking your partner's text messages or monitoring who they see.

questions.q: What is said about asking for help with jealousy?
options: Most people ask for help very quickly
Only men ask for help
Many people don't feel brave enough to ask
Doctors refuse to help
questions.why: Unlike anxiety or OCD, many do not feel brave enough to ask for help with jealousy.

questions.q: What does Dr Johan Ahlen recommend for jealousy?
options: Taking a special pill every morning
Ending the relationship as soon as possible
Spending more time alone to calm down
Therapy to reduce checking on others
questions.why: He suggests cognitive behavioural therapy to decrease monitoring and checking and increase positive behaviours.

questions.q: What does Sam suggest Neil could do instead of feeling jealous?
options: Stop being friends with Alicia for a while
Feel happy that Alicia has a new friend
Ask Jenny to stay away from Alicia
Invite himself along to their lunches
questions.why: She says try feeling happy that she's made a new friend.
